'''Outrider Cup''' is the Players Committee biennial Europe versus United States team event on GEMP. Six players a side is the published format: Player of the Year points plus a captain's pick, unique objectives per team, and a race to seven. [[Chris Gogolen]] designed the first Cup.

[[Team USA]] won [[2019 Outrider Cup]], [[2023 Outrider Cup III]], and [[2026 Outrider Cup IV]]. [[Team Europe]] won [[2021 Outrider Cup]] on a captains' tiebreaker after the 12 regulation games finished 6–6.
